title: Reservations Schedule: Night Allowance on Longer Extensions of a Respite and Short-Term Stay
content:
**Added nights.** The added nights of an extension under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement run from the planned departure date on record up to the requested date, that is the requested date less the planned departure date in calendar days. The requested date is the one stated on the extension request registered on the stay and awaiting signature.

**Allowance.** The billed added nights are counted by one of three methods: for fourteen or more added nights (14 or more), the price of one added night in every seven is not charged; for seven to thirteen added nights (7 to 13), the price of one added night is not charged; for fewer added nights (6 or fewer), every added night is charged.

For 14 added nights or more, the nights whose price is not charged are the number of whole sevens in the added nights; a remainder of fewer than seven adds none. The extension charges the price of an added night for the billed added nights.

## Billed added nights by length

| Added nights | Nights not charged | Billed added nights |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | 0 | 5 |
| 6 | 0 | 6 |
| 7 | 1 | 6 |
| 10 | 1 | 9 |
| 13 | 1 | 12 |
| 14 | 2 | 12 |
| 15 | 2 | 13 |
| 21 | 3 | 18 |

## Hypothetical illustration

A planned departure date of 1 June on record and an extension request for 11 June give 10 added nights; at a price of 284.00 per added night, 9 nights are charged, that is 2,556.00.
